task: Explain how a bill becomes a law in a parliament, for a student who writes a school report. Name what a student should check in a source.

en.title: Cost: no web search
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The researcher answers from what the model knows.

**What it teaches**

Without search a run is cheap, but the answer has no sources.
